SELECT page_code, model menuName, count(id) menuVisitCount FROM up_statistics_pv where id is not null
AND type = #{query.useFrequencyPlateType}
AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
AND YEARWEEK(create_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1)
AND YEAR(create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(create_time) = MONTH(CURDATE())
AND DATE(create_time) BETWEEN #{query.useFrequencyStartDate} AND #{query.useFrequencyEndDate}
GROUP BY model order by menuVisitCount desc limit 50

select t.date keyword, SUM(t.timeDiff) count from (SELECT DATE(ol.create_time) date, TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, MIN(ol.create_time), MAX(ol.create_time) ) as timeDiff FROM t_user_operate_log ol LEFT JOIN t_base_user u on u.id = ol.user_id LEFT JOIN t_role_user ru on u.id = ru.user_id LEFT JOIN t_role r on r.id = ru.role_id where r.id = #{query.usePlateUserType} and ol.module not like concat('%','登录','%')
AND DATE(ol.create_time) = CURDATE()
and YEARWEEK(ol.create_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1)
AND YEAR(ol.create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(ol.create_time) = MONTH(CURDATE())
AND DATE(ol.create_time) BETWEEN #{query.usePlateStartDate} AND#{query.usePlateEndDate}
GROUP BY DATE(ol.create_time),u.id,ol.access_terminal ) t GROUP BY t.DATE ORDER BY t.date
